posts.title: Why Mamburi, Malindi Is the Place to Own Your Next Home
posts.excerpt: Ten minutes from Malindi Town on the Lamu Highway, Mamburi blends coastal calm with easy access — and our 3-bedroom ensuite maisonettes start at KSh 5.7M.
posts.author: Equity Premier

body.text: Malindi has long been one of Kenya's most loved coastal towns. Mamburi, just 10 minutes away along the Lamu Highway, gives you the best of both worlds: a quiet, secure neighbourhood with town, schools, hospitals and the beach all within easy reach.
Strategically located on the Lamu Highway
Good roads make daily life easier and help homes hold their value. Being right on the Lamu Highway means smooth commutes into Malindi Town and a direct route up the coast.

body.caption: Modern coastal living, minutes from town.

body.text: Spacious, all-ensuite maisonettes

Each maisonette has three bedrooms, every one ensuite, with premium finishes and interiors you can customise. Priced at KSh 5.7M, you can secure yours with a KSh 2M booking and flexible financing for the balance.
Your dream home is closer than you think.

posts.title: Buying Your First Home in Kenya: A Simple Step-by-Step Guide
posts.excerpt: From viewing to booking to handover — what to check, what to ask and how flexible financing works when you buy an off-plan or ready home.
posts.author: Equity Premier

body.text: Buying your first home is one of the biggest decisions you will make. Here is how to approach it with confidence.
1. Visit the site
Always view the home or show unit in person. Look at the finishes, the neighbourhood, access roads and security.
2. Understand the price and booking
Ask for the full price, the booking amount and the payment schedule in writing. For our Mamburi maisonettes, that is KSh 5.7M with a KSh 2M booking.
3. Review the documents
Check the sale agreement and ownership documents with a lawyer before you commit.
4. Personalise and plan the handover
If interiors are customisable, agree on your choices early so your home is ready the way you want it.
